headline: Congress approved a resolution appointing Denise O'Leary as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
what_it_does: This joint resolution names Denise O'Leary to serve as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Board of Regents oversees the Smithsonian, which is a group of museums, research centers, and the National Zoo. The summary does not describe any other changes, funding, or new rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on April 10, 2020.
